scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @loomrail/contracts && npm run build -w @loomrail/providers && npm run build -w @loomrail/engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @loomrail/server && npm run build -w @loomrail/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @loomrail/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @loomrail/server
scripts.worker: npm run build:packages && npm run worker -w @loomrail/server
scripts.operator:init: npm run build:packages && npm run operator:init -w @loomrail/server
scripts.demo: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/demo.ts
scripts.demo:record: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/record-demo.ts
